title: Locker and Homecoming
author: Marguerite Reyes
blurb: Wren Zhou, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
